text.title: Multi-Region Failover Pattern Pack — Output Contract
text.summary: JSON Schema (draft-07) for the failover pattern pack: numeric `rpo_minutes` / `rto_minutes` inputs per workload tier, one chosen pattern with achievable RPO/RTO and secondary capacity and quotas, DNS mechanics (TTL at most 60 s, health check, observed propagation, TTL-ignoring clients), database replication mode with measured p99 lag, promotion and fencing, object-store replication with backfill and backlog alert, region-scoped dependency list with bypasses, the live drill checklist and last measured result, and the failback procedure. Validator in scripts/validate-multi-region-failover-pattern-pack.py enforces it, including achievable-versus-required and lag-versus-RPO.

required.field: `mechanism`; for dns-failover: `ttl_seconds` at most 60, `health_check` (endpoint, interval, failure threshold), `observed_propagation_seconds`; `ttl_ignoring_clients[]` each with a `fallback` (r-dns-failover-ttl-and-health-check)
every dependency on the failover path with `kind`, `reachable_from_secondary`, and `bypass` when not reachable (r-region-scoped-dependencies-listed)

names exactly the chosen pattern; carries the word `unverified` when the last drill is missing or older than the last mechanics change (r-pattern-chosen-from-rpo-rto-and-cost, r-drill-live-with-measured-results)
at least one URL: drill report, replication dashboard, quota request, backfill job

forbidden.pattern: `rpo_minutes` / `rto_minutes` missing or non-numeric, or asynchronous replication with `rpo_minutes` × 60 below `p99_lag_seconds_30d` — fm-01
`drill.last` null, or `drill.last.date` before `drill.mechanics_last_changed_at`, without `unverified` in `decision` — fm-02
dns-failover with `ttl_seconds` above 60, no `health_check`, or no `observed_propagation_seconds` — fm-04
`existing_objects_backfilled: true` with no `backfill_job`, or no `backlog_metric` — fm-05
a dependency with `reachable_from_secondary: false` and no `bypass` — fm-06

`achievable_rto_minutes` above `rto_minutes` or `achievable_rpo_minutes` above `rpo_minutes`; `decision` naming zero or two patterns, or a pattern other than `pattern.chosen` — r-pattern-chosen-from-rpo-rto-and-cost

list.item: `pattern.chosen` is one of five, `achievable_*` are at or below the required numbers, secondary capacity and `quotas_verified` are recorded, and `decision` names that pattern once (r-pattern-chosen-from-rpo-rto-and-cost).
For dns-failover: TTL at most 60 s, health check endpoint / interval / threshold, propagation from the last drill, TTL-ignoring clients with fallbacks (r-dns-failover-ttl-and-health-check).
Replication mode, 30-day p99 lag, promotion, fencing and single-writer enforcement are stated; async lag in seconds is at most `rpo_minutes` × 60 (r-database-replication-mode-and-promotion).
Object-store replication and versioning on, backlog metric and replication-time alert named, backfill status recorded with the job (r-object-store-replication-verified).
Every dependency on the failover path is listed; each unreachable one has a bypass (r-region-scoped-dependencies-listed).
Drill checklist present; `drill.last` measured since the last mechanics change, or `decision` says `unverified` (r-drill-live-with-measured-results).
Failback has its own RPO/RTO, trigger, reconciliation and procedure (r-failback-procedure-included).
